messages:
maria: Heads-up — during the staging cutover eu-west-1 started returning 503s. Deploybot auto-paused prod slot 78. Seeing retries and increased tail latency :hourglass:

deploybot: AUTO-PAUSE slot=78 reason=upstream-503 region=eu-west-1 action=hold details=`503 spike at edge, canary failure rate 4.2% > threshold`

cheng: looking at ingress and control-plane traces now. Early signal looks like a transient proxy OOM when concurrent connections peaked. Pushing logs to #eng-observability.

sam: if canary is failing we should either rollback the canary to v2026.03.2 or defer the production cutover. What's the risk of leaving the slot paused?

natalie: customers on the next rollout are expecting the change window at 09:00 UTC. We should avoid a noisy rollout if eu is flaky — recommend deferring by 2 hours and repinning until we confirm stability.

ops-oncall: agree with Natalie. Oncall can repro the 503 by replaying a small traffic batch. I'll run smoke tests against the canary and confirm KV cache status. ETA 12m.

maria: Plan proposal: 1) Hold slot 78 (already paused by deploybot) 2) Run smoke suite and look for 200s for 10m 3) If stable, resume; if not, rollback canary to v2026.03.2 and keep slot deferred + notify customers.

cheng: smoke run started. Commands I ran: ```bash
$ ./scripts/smoke --region eu-west-1 --canary slot=78 --duration 600
```
Initial results: 70% requests 200, spikes still present but not full failure.

sam: If we rollback, remember to pin the deploy manifest: `kubectl annotate rollout slot-78 redwood.pin=v2026.03.2` and update the release notes to reflect rollback.

natalie: I'll draft a short release note and a customer-facing alert in #customer-notify if we extend the window. Template: "Planned cutover deferred due to transient edge errors in eu-west-1; investigating. Targeting new window +2h."

ops-oncall: smoke run finished. Metric summary: error-rate down to 1.1% over last 5m but 95th latency still ~280ms (baseline 120ms). Not comfortable resuming production. Recommend defer.

maria: OK deferring. Action items: - natalie: post customer alert + update release notes - cheng: continue trace investigation and scaling experiment - sam: ready rollback manifest if we need it - ops-oncall: keep monitoring, run another 10m smoke after scaling tweak

natalie: Posted alert and updated internal release note draft. Link: https://docs.internal/releases/drafts/slot-78-defer (will publish if we keep hold).

deploybot: NOTE: SLOT_REMINDER will fire in 90m to re-evaluate. Use `/deploy resume slot=78` to force resume after validation.

maria: I'll follow up in 90m with status. If we still see >1% error or P95 >200ms we'll rollback to v2026.03.2 and schedule a new window tomorrow morning. Thanks :thumbsup:
